decision: build/15-rishennia-komplektu.md, «Мікроконтролери»: standard MicroPython UF2 plus a copy of the reviewed files; every UF2 pinned by SHA-256. Flashing is a bench step; nothing here records a device as flashed.

imu.why_this_build: micropython.org has a WAVESHARE_RP2040_ZERO board build only from v1.28.0 (the earliest listed); its board definition sets the Zero's own flash clock divider (pico-sdk waveshare_rp2040_zero.h PICO_FLASH_SPI_CLKDIV 4, RPI_PICO uses 2) and Waveshare's wiki asks for board firmware on its RP boards. The IMU firmware API target moves from 1.26.0 to 1.28.0; the board run on the bench (firmware/imu/README.md) is the check.

flash_erase.purpose: clean flash before a re-install: the Pico's main.py runs a 1000 ms hardware WDT that a REPL session cannot stop, so files are never edited over a running supervisor
flash_erase.release: raspberrypi/pico-sdk-prebuilts v2.3.1-0 (2026-09-06), release-API digest equals the bytes

mpremote.install: python3 -m venv --copies /opt/srrx/mcu-venv && /opt/srrx/mcu-venv/bin/python3 -m pip install --no-index --find-links=<wheel dir> --require-hashes -r firmware/mpremote-requirements.txt
